passage: Last month, I decided to start morning exercise. My doctor warned me that I sat too much in front of the computer. On the first day, I walked to the park near my home at six in the morning. The air smelled fresh and the birds sang loudly. I joined a group of old people who danced slowly to music. At first, my legs hurt and I wanted to stop. An old man with white hair smiled and told me to walk a little every day. I listened to his advice and kept walking. After two weeks, I felt stronger and slept better at night. I lost two kilos and my back stopped hurting. Now I exercise for thirty minutes every morning. I play with a badminton group on weekends and drink more water. My doctor checked me last week and praised my progress. Exercise changed my life, and I never want to stop.

sentences.text: My doctor warned me that I sat too much in front of the computer.
An old man with white hair smiled and told me to walk a little every day.
After two weeks, I felt stronger and slept better at night.

vocab.note: “建议”；不可数名词，永远不加 s（不是 advices）
“锻炼”；动词和名词同形，重音都在第一个音节
“进步”（名词）；重音在前，动词“进展”时重音在后
